analyst_view.overall: Nordsjaelland (25th, 2 pts) host Panathinaikos (2nd, 9 pts from 3 wins): the Danes need a win to climb into the top 24, while Panathinaikos are close to a top-eight place. Nordsjaelland have been scoring freely at home, 6-1 at Randers and, per FotMob, 5-0 against FC Copenhagen this weekend, form the numbers barely see because Danish league stats are not in the model; their games have been open (3-3, 2-2, 2-3). Panathinaikos, coached by former Copenhagen boss Jacob Neestrup, lead the Greek league and have won their last five, but one report (a team-news page) says Santino Andino, their man of the match against AEK, is suspended after three yellow cards, and they play Atromitos three days later, so rotation is likely. Nordsjaelland's keeper Busk is a doubt; the numbers carry no missing players for either side and already count Panathinaikos' recent card count. No referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, split 1.5 to 1.3. I lean a little higher: Nordsjaelland have scored 11 in their last two league games and their matches keep finishing high, while Panathinaikos may rotate and, per one report, lose Andino to a ban; the numbers can't see the Danish form. +5% gives about 2.9 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, split evenly. Both sides like the ball (Panathinaikos average 59% possession in this competition) and the numbers already reflect their corner records, so I stay at about 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards and already add about 10% for Panathinaikos' recent bookings (6 yellows in 3 European games). A rotated Panathinaikos side with little to lose could be calmer, but that is a guess and no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots, a little below a usual game and already raised 5% for Nordsjaelland's recent volume. Nordsjaelland's home attack should push that up, but a Panathinaikos side keeping the ball can slow the game, so I stay at about 26.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target, already nudged up for both sides' recent accuracy. Nordsjaelland's sharp finishing in the league, which the numbers can't see, and a possibly weakened Panathinaikos midfield point slightly higher: +3% gives about 9.9.
